'''Mauro Sarmiento''' (born August 10, 1983) is an Italian martial artist. He was born in [[Casoria|Casoria, Italy]], and represented Italy in [[Taekwondo at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Men's 80 kg]], and won the silver medal, upsetting two-time Olympic champion [[Steven López]] of the [[United States]] in the quarterfinals.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.chron.com/disp/story.mpl/sports/5959155.html |title=Houston Chronicle |access-date=2010-01-31 |archive-date=2011-06-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110604032854/http://www.chron.com/disp/story.mpl/sports/5959155.html |url-status=live }}</ref> In the gold medal round he lost to [[Hadi Saei]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.espn.com/espn/wire?section=oly&id=3548242 |title=ESPN |access-date=2024-07-23 |archive-date=2020-07-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200720145904/https://www.espn.com/espn/wire?section=oly&id=3548242 |url-status=live }}</ref>

At the [[2012 Summer Olympics]], he won the bronze medal in the [[Taekwondo at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Men's 80 kg|men's -80 kg taekwondo]] event, losing to [[Nicolás García (taekwondo)|Nicolas Garcia]] in the semi-finals, and then beating [[Nesar Ahmad Bahave|Nesar Ahmad Bahawi]] in his bronze medal match.<ref>{{Cite web|title = 68 - 80 kg men results - Taekwondo - London 2012 Olympics|url = http://www.olympic.org/olympic-results/london-2012/taekwondo/68-80-kg-m|website = www.olympic.org|accessdate = 2015-06-03|archive-date = 2014-12-13|archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20141213232907/http://www.olympic.org/olympic-results/london-2012/taekwondo/68-80-kg-m|url-status = live}}</ref>
